notes.title: Trading Cards
notes.content:
I'm very proud to release this set of Cards and backgrounds, designed by JAdkins of the Still eating oranges art collective. 
http://stilleatingoranges.tumblr.com/

He came to my attension through his work on "Hyper bounce blast" and "Screw you bear dad", also through the collectives support of my work.

http://stilleatingoranges.tumblr.com/post/121962488784/currently-an-indie-game-called-uriels-chasm

I originally couldn't see how our styles would be compatible but I thought it would be challenging and highly interesting to see how he approached the myriad of feverish subject matter that is Ohr. 

Here is a more in depth look at the creation of each one.

http://stilleatingoranges.tumblr.com/post/158085402509/after-a-few-setbacks-the-artworks-are-now-public

I could not have been happier and more inspired than with the games iconic cover art, in the true sense of iconography.

Please enjoy and consider supporting this artist as well as the co- musician of Ohr F.tyler's work.

notes.title: Uncensoring angel rape.
notes.content:
I'm not sure how it happened, it's far beyond me to censor anything but some how the context of Angel rape got cut, despite that sort of being a main theme to the self defence sections.

We also have the Biblical themes of Sodom and Gomorrah that was designed to tie into.  


also, a bit of ASMR fun.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yLEBEwiwbFM :P

notes.title: HanzVonStickyhooves honorary first look at Ohr
notes.content:
They get kind of lost, as you will to going in blind. But they are funny guys that  I love confounding with weird mechanics for them to riff off, you should check out and subscribe.


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3xlyOCywnXQ

some things you can do they didnt work out:

Press A(action) and speak to each character regardless of what color cassette you have  (current color cassette is displayed in the HUD).

The way to win the shmup part is to charge your shot by grazing bullets then fill the exit bar with the kills you amass.
